features.justification_quote: These experiments deliberately elicit distress-like outputs in order to measure and mitigate them

features.quote: makes elicitation explicit and opt-in per stage
ships a `--dry-run` plan-only mode and `--limit` caps on every entry point so nothing runs by accident
keeps the *mitigation* (DPO) as a first-class, equally-supported path rather than an afterthought
drawn from the already-scored vanilla elicitation rollouts so we don't re-sample distress unnecessarily
the amount of distress elicitation are visible before anything runs
features.justification_quote: so the cost and the amount of distress elicitation are visible before anything runs
